name.full: objekts Production Desk — Visual Production Preflight

description.short: AI/VFX, CGI, motion and animation production preflight by objekts.
description.full: objekts Production Desk is an agent-native production preflight system built by objekts, a visual-production studio working across AI/VFX, CGI/3D, motion, animation and commercial production. It helps Microsoft 365 agents diagnose hard visual locks, reference authority, asset fitness, continuity, versioning and change impact; select the first useful proof-of-concept; calculate scoped estimates only when explicitly requested; and optionally hand a prepared brief to the human objekts production team.
